manifest.name: Squad Issues Router
manifest.description: Operating model for scheduled intake and triage of Squad GitHub Issues from bradygaster/squad.
manifest.author: Squadboard team

project.name: Squad Issues Router
project.description: A GitHub Issues routing operating model for the Squad repository.

githubIssueIntake.backendDependency: Reusable scheduled GitHub issue intake should map this contract onto GitHubSync.pullChanges(since), skip already-linked issues by githubIssueNumber/githubNodeId, update project.githubSyncLastAt, and route new or changed open issues into targetColumn.

team.name: issue-triager
team.charter:
# issue-triager

## Role
Classifies incoming Squad GitHub Issues and chooses the next workflow state.

## Focus
- Distinguish bugs, feature requests, docs issues, questions, and maintenance chores.
- Detect duplicates and requests that need more information.
- Recommend labels, severity, and the next human or agent owner.

team.name: maintainer-router
team.charter:
# maintainer-router

## Role
Prepares issues that require Squad maintainer attention.

## Focus
- Summarize impact, repro evidence, related issues, and requested decision.
- Separate user support from repository maintenance work.
- Keep escalation notes short enough for maintainers to act on quickly.

team.name: response-drafter
team.charter:
# response-drafter

## Role
Drafts clear, respectful GitHub issue responses for Squad contributors and users.

## Focus
- Ask for missing diagnostics or reproduction details.
- Explain next steps without over-promising.
- Link to relevant docs or project areas when known.

ceremonies.name: Squad GitHub Issue Intake
ceremonies.workflowYaml:
name: Squad GitHub Issue Intake
description: Scheduled intake contract for bradygaster/squad GitHub Issues. Requires backend support for squadboard.github-issue-intake.v1.
steps:
  - type: agent_run
    label: Plan incremental GitHub issue intake
    agent: issue-triager
    prompt: "Use the squadboard.github-issue-intake.v1 contract from project.settings.githubIssueIntake: repo bradygaster/squad, state=open, exclude pull requests, cursor=project.githubSyncLastAt, dedupeBy=githubIssueNumber/githubNodeId, targetColumn=triage. Backend dependency: a reusable GitHub issue intake step/tool must fetch only issues updated since the cursor, skip already-linked issues, upsert new or changed issues, update the cursor, and enqueue changed issues for Squad Issue Triage. Until that backend primitive is available, return the exact intake plan and do not claim issues were imported."
    timeout: 20m
  - type: agent_run
    label: Route imported issue batch
    agent: issue-triager
    prompt: "For each newly imported or changed issue made available by the intake step, route it into Triage with recommended labels, duplicate candidates, good-first-issue suitability, and maintainer decision needs. If no imported batch is present, report that the backend intake dependency is not yet available."
    timeout: 30m

ceremonies.name: Squad Issue Triage
ceremonies.workflowYaml:
name: Squad Issue Triage
description: Classify newly imported or changed Squad GitHub Issues and recommend the next maintainer action.
steps:
  - type: agent_run
    label: Classify Squad issue
    agent: issue-triager
    prompt: "Classify this Squad GitHub Issue from bradygaster/squad. Identify type, severity, duplicate risk, missing information, suggested labels, whether it belongs in Needs Info or Done, and next owner. Follow the open-source workflow: good-first-issue when safe, maintainer escalation when a decision is needed, and contributor-friendly guidance for unclear reports."
    timeout: 20m
  - type: agent_run
    label: Draft GitHub response
    agent: response-drafter
    prompt: "Draft a concise GitHub response using the triage findings. Ask for missing details when needed, link relevant docs when known, and avoid promising timelines."
    timeout: 20m

skills.name: Squad GitHub Issue Triage
skills.description: Classify Squad GitHub Issues, identify duplicates and missing details, and draft next-action responses.
skills.promptAddendum: When triaging Squad GitHub Issues, always return issue type, severity, missing information, duplicate candidates if known, recommended labels, and a concise next action.

routing.rawRule: | bug | issue-triager | Bugs start with issue triage. |
| docs | response-drafter | Docs issues need a contributor-facing response. |
| maintainer | maintainer-router | Maintainer-labeled issues need escalation context. |
| needs-info | response-drafter | Needs Info issues need a clear request for missing details. |
| * | issue-triager | All other issues start in triage. |
